description: Attach a server to a private network, optionally assigning a specific IP, alias IPs, or IP range.

alias_ips.description: Additional alias IPs to assign the server on the network

ip.description: Private IP to assign the server in the network (within the network IP range)

ip_range.description: Subnet IP range (CIDR) to attach to, e.g. "10.0.1.0/24"

network.description: ID of the network to attach the server to

name: hetzner_attach_server_to_network
title: Attach Server to Network
